# Stage 02: Assemble Evidence

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Assemble the minimum evidence needed to perform the selected process.

## Inputs

| Source | Section or file | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Prior stage | `../01-select-and-tailor/process-brief.md` | Selected process and tailoring |
| Control root | `source-index.md`, `project-control.md`, relevant registers and indexed artifacts | Current project evidence |
| Reference | Selected file under `references/processes/` | Process inputs and checks |
| Reference | `references/artifact-management/CONTEXT.md`, `process-artifact-map.md`, `artifact-catalog.md`, `artifact-need-rules.md` | Candidate artifacts and gate sequence |
| Reference | `essential-artifact-model.md`, `disposition-rules.md`, `artifact-completeness-model.md`, `evidence-standards.md` | Need, treatment, completeness, and confidence rules |
| Template | `templates/artifact-need-gate.md` | Required gate fields inside the evidence package |
| PMI source | Selected PMBOK section from the process map | Technical basis when needed |

## Process

1. Read the process brief and load only the source locations it names.
2. Check the relevant project records, registers, and external source sections.
3. Record evidence with path, section or item, date, and confidence where known.
4. Separate facts, user statements, inference, and unresolved conflict.
5. Record missing evidence as an explicit gap and identify the smallest next action.
6. Filter the catalog to the candidates mapped to the selected process and inspect existing carriers before comparing treatments.
7. Apply the Artifact Need Gate for each relevant candidate: decide need first, then treatment, with evidence, confidence, trigger, and next review trigger.
8. Record the gate result in the evidence package. If no maintained artifact is justified, state `No additional artifact is currently needed.`
9. Do not copy external documents into the control root or run folder.

## Outputs

| Artifact | Location | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Evidence package | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/02-assemble-evidence/evidence-package.md` | Markdown |

## Validation

| Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|
| Relevance | Every loaded source supports the selected process |
| Traceability | Each material fact has a location and section or item |
| Gaps | Missing or conflicting evidence is stated |
| Artifact gate | Every mapped candidate has a need and treatment, or an explicit reason it is not assessed |
| Existing carriers | Existing artifacts are inspected before any Create disposition |
| View handling | Generated views name source records and human validation point |
| Source handling | No external source was copied |
| Context | Unrelated process domains and records were not loaded |
